title: tool_select MCP accepts 'freeTranform' (misspelled) instead of 'free-transform'
description: In registry.ts, the validTools array contains 'freeTranform' (missing 's', no hyphen). The actual tool ID used throughout the codebase (ToolsPanel.tsx, StageArea.tsx, types.ts) is 'free-transform'. An MCP agent calling tool_select({ toolId: 'free-transform' }) gets an 'Unknown toolId' error. Fix: replace 'freeTranform' with 'free-transform' in the validTools array.
